fields.description: Minimum days between two calving events for the same animal. Default 270 (~9 months).
fields.label: Minimum Calving Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum age (months) of the herd where newborn calves are placed. Matches Herds.min_age.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd Min Age

fields.description: Maximum age (months) of the herd where newborn calves are placed. Matches Herds.max_age.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd Max Age

fields.description: Animal must be at least this age (months) before it can be served/inseminated.
fields.label: Minimum Service Age (Months)

fields.description: Animal must be at least this age (months) to record a calving event.
fields.label: Minimum Calving Age (Months)

fields.description: Service is blocked before this many days after a Calving.
fields.label: Minimum Days to Service After Calving

fields.description: Service is allowed but warned about before this many days after a Calving. Also sets Ready For Service Date.
fields.label: Optimal Days to Service After Calving

fields.description: Service is blocked before this many days after an Abortion. Set to 0 to disable.
fields.label: Minimum Days to Service After Abortion

fields.description: Expected Calving Date = service date + this.
fields.label: Gestation Period (days)

fields.description: How many days before the expected calving date the reminder fires.
fields.label: Calving Alert Lead (days)

fields.description: Pregnancy diagnosis earlier than this warns about accuracy.
fields.label: Earliest Reliable Diagnosis (days after service)

fields.description: Pregnancy diagnosis later than this warns as overdue.
fields.label: Latest Expected Diagnosis (days after service)

fields.description: Calves created by a Birth event go to this herd. If unset, the calf-rearing herd is resolved automatically.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd

fields.description: Minimum days between identical vaccinations for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Vaccination Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum days between deworming events for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Deworming Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum age for dehorning. Usually done on young calves.
fields.label: Min Dehorning Age (Months)

fields.description: Maximum recommended age for dehorning.
fields.label: Max Dehorning Age (Months)

fields.description: Minimum days between weight recordings for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Weight Recording Interval (Days)

fields.description: A herd that is weighed monthly is flagged when an animal has gone longer than this plus the grace days without a weighing.
fields.label: Weighing Interval (Days)

fields.description: Days of slack after the weighing interval before an animal counts as overdue. 0 means no slack.
fields.label: Weighing Grace (Days)

fields.description: The method the Weights screens (web and mobile) start on.
fields.label: Weighing Method Default
fields.options:
Weighbridge
Platform Scale
Heart Girth Tape
Visual Estimate

fields.description: Untick when the farm has no weighbridge: the Weights screens stop offering it as a method.
fields.label: Weighbridge Available

fields.description: Minimum days between hoof trimming for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Hoof Trimming Interval (Days)

fields.description: Store where manufactured feed (TMR) is produced and held.
fields.label: Feed WIP / Store Warehouse

fields.description: Warehouses feed inputs may be drawn from, in search order. The first row that can cover a line in full is the one the Work Order transfers from. The Feed WIP / Store Warehouse above is always tried last.
fields.label: Feed Source Warehouses

fields.description: Concentrates the farm buys ready-packed. A concentrate that is mixed on the farm is recognised by its BOM and does not belong here — list only the ones that arrive already made, so the feeding programme flags them as concentrate rather than plain raw material.
fields.label: Bought-in Concentrates

fields.description: The item group this farm keeps its feed in — raw materials, mixed concentrate and bought-in alike. The Stock page shows this group and nothing else, and a new ration or concentrate is created in it. Left blank it uses “DAIRY”.
fields.label: Feed Item Group

fields.description: Default straw item for a Service when none is chosen on the event.
fields.label: Default Semen Item

fields.description: Where a CONCENTRATE mix books to. A mix has no herd — it is made for the store and eaten by several herds — so the herd's own cost centre cannot answer for it. Left blank it falls to the per-company row below, which is the answer for everything herdless.
fields.label: Concentrate Cost Center

fields.description: Charged for feed, drug and husbandry stock movements when the herd names no cost centre of its own. One row per company — one company's centre is not another's. ERPNext refuses a stock entry outright when the item's expense account is a P&L one and no cost centre can be found.
fields.label: Default Cost Centres by Company

fields.description: Which herd a newborn enters. A calf's sex decides this and nothing else does.
fields.label: A · Calf Intake

fields.description: Normally the first rung of the growth ladder below.
fields.label: Female Calf Herd

fields.description: Male calves.
fields.label: Male Calf Herd

fields.description: The herds a heifer climbs before she is old enough to serve, in order. The first row is where female calves land; the last should be marked 'exits on service'.
fields.label: B · Growth Ladder

fields.description: Where a served heifer waits out her first pregnancy.
fields.label: C · First Pregnancy

fields.description: Entered on a CONFIRMED pregnancy, never on the service alone.
fields.label: Incalf Heifer Herd

fields.description: After her first calving a cow never returns to the growth ladder. She cycles between these herds for the rest of her productive life.
fields.label: D · Breeding Herds

fields.description: A cow that has not conceived in this many days is flagged as open too long.
fields.label: Maximum Open Days

fields.description: While this is on, backdated records skip the age, interval and duplicate guards. Today's records are always guarded. Turn it off once the history load is finished.
fields.label: Backdating Open

fields.description: Warn when a concentrate has fewer days of cover than this. 7 suits a farm that mixes weekly — below a week, the next mix cannot wait for the next mixing day. 0 turns the check off.
fields.label: Concentrate Cover Warning (days)
Health Cases
fields.description: A case is a file, and a file left open is a cow nobody has closed the book on.

fields.label: Concern After (days open)
fields.description: How long a health case may stay open before the farm wants to know about it. A cow three weeks under treatment is either not recovering or her file was never closed, and both are worth seeing. 0 turns the check off.

fields.label: Untouched For (days)
fields.description: An open case with no treatment recorded for this long is stale — nobody has written anything down, whatever is or is not happening in the shed. 0 turns the check off.

fields.label: Business & Farm
fields.description: Where livestock sales are booked.

fields.label: Disposal Farm
fields.description: Farm for Sales Invoice on animal disposals.

fields.label: Disposal Business Unit
fields.description: Business Unit for Sales Invoice on animal disposals.

fields.label: Animal Sale Item
fields.description: Item used on Sales Invoices when an animal is sold.

fields.label: Default Insurance Payout %
fields.description: Used for a claim when its policy names no payout percentage.

fields.label: Transitional Milk Days 2-5 (% of body weight per day)
Whole Milk Days 6+ (% of body weight per day)
Heifer herds
fields.description: The herds that hold heifers (for example the service heifers). The mobile app's Heifers filter shows the animals in these herds.

fields.label: In-calf herds
fields.description: The herds where in-calf animals go. The mobile app's In-calf filter shows only the animals in these herds.

fields.label: Calf herds
fields.description: The calf groups (for example the bull calves, 0-2 and 2-4). The mobile app's Calves filter shows the animals in these herds.

fields.label: Event stock rules
fields.options: Whether an event posts a Stock Entry, the item groups it draws on, its default store and whether it must name an item are set per event type — on each Livestock Event Type, or all together on the app's Settings → Stock tab.

fields.description: Where a cow goes the moment she calves, and where she is served again from. Leave blank to keep her in the herd she is in.
fields.label: Cow herd (after calving)
